source_title: LMT Onsrud Drill Cutting Data Recommendations (PCT-19 catalogue page 124)
coverage_notes: One page, 756 398 bytes (the same size the 2026-08-04 audit recorded). Prints chip load per tooth by cutting diameter for series 72-000* Wood: 3 mm .009-.011, 5 mm .011-.013, 6 mm .013-.015, 8 mm .015-.017 in/tooth; footnote '* Gang drills run at 4,500 RPM and 150 IPM'. Also plastic (70-500) and composite drill series. No peck, hole-depth or depth-to-diameter guidance. No species or category split ('Wood' only). 4 candidate rows, derived grade b: the band is printed, the family assignment is not (R5 shared-column rule).

source_title: LMT Onsrud Production Cutting Tools Catalog PCT-19
coverage_notes: Full catalogue (20.9 MB). Used for two facts only: (1) page 90, the 72-000 Series Boring Bits product tables print Flutes = 2 for every brad-point and through-hole part at 3, 5, 6 and 8 mm (the column header says '(in)' but the values are millimetres), material icons SW HW CW LW; (2) page 32, the 34-100 potted-fastener tool (composite honeycomb panels, not wood) prints 'RPM 10,000 / Plunge Feed Rate 40 IPM / Feed Rate 80 IPM' - a plunge of one half of the feed, for composites only. The Technical Data pages (109-112) print no plunge, peck or drill guidance for wood. 0 candidate rows (supports the Onsrud rows).

stored_text_extra: sources/leitz_lexicon7_06_drilling_red_spans.txt (sha256 b31e2f728492ff2f21f8194d4bbfd4e4f5532358459ac6632705dcda84f56e90): the red worked-example values read from the PDF text layer with scripts/g6_leitz_red_points.py
coverage_notes: 59 pages. PDF page = printed page + 2. Each tool page prints a diagram 'Feed speed vf depending on the spindle RPM n' (vf in m/min against n in 1/min) with one red worked example in the text layer, a base workpiece material, printed correction factors for other materials, Z (teeth) in the tool heading and an RPM range. The plotted bands are graphics and are not transcribed. Dowel drills (Z2, D 3-10 mm): 2 m/min at 4500 1/min on chipboard plastic coated, corrections MDF/solid wood 0.7, chipboard uncoated 1.3, veneered 0.8. Twist and Levin drills in softwood/solid wood: 1.2-4.5 m/min at 2500-4500 1/min. Printed depth guidance: 'When drilling holes with a depth greater than 4 x D interim clearance stroke is recommended!' (PDF p36); Levin drill 'Suitable for depths up to approx. 4 x D without interim clearance strokes' and 'Drilling depth > 4 x D = 0.8' (PDF p43-44); boring pins 'Infeed depth in hardwood and glulam maximum 2 x D' and 'Interim chip removal (return stroke) then is obligatory' (PDF p13). No chip load is printed anywhere; every chip load is derived vf*1000/(n*Z). 13 candidate rows (all derived grade b; three of them apply a printed correction factor: MDF 0.7, solid wood 0.7, chipboard uncoated 1.3) and 8 depth statements.

source_title: PreciseBits Hardwood Fingerboard Planing and Radiusing - 3-flute up-cut end-mills (product page)
coverage_notes: HTML page; the hash is of the stored text file. One tool: radiused end mill D 0.125 in / 3.0 mm, tip radius 0.64 mm, 3 flutes. Prints plunge rate by wood hardness: softwood (Janka < 1,500) 75 in/min, medium hardwood (1,500-2,500) 50 in/min, high hardness (> 2,500) 40 in/min. No RPM printed ('use your maximum RPM'), so no plunge chip load follows. The only vendor plunge FEED RATE for a router end mill in wood found. 4 candidate rows (feed rate only, chipload null; the < 1,500 band is emitted for softwood 600 and hardwood 1450, the engine's Janka proxies).

source_title: Recommended Diablo Forstner Bit Speed Chart
